general.q: Which planet in our solar system has the highest average surface temperature?
general.why: Venus traps extreme heat beneath a thick carbon dioxide atmosphere, reaching over 460°C.

general.q: Which British politician established the Metropolitan Police force in 1829?
general.why: Sir Robert Peel created the force, inspiring nicknames for officers like 'bobbies' and 'peelers'.

general.q: What is the largest internal organ in the human body?
general.why: While the skin is the largest organ overall, the liver is the heaviest and largest inside the body.

general.q: Which African kingdom is entirely surrounded by the territory of South Africa?
general.why: Lesotho is an enclaved sovereign country completely encircled by its single neighbour, South Africa.

general.q: What is the SI unit of electrical resistance?
general.why: Named after German physicist Georg Ohm, it quantifies how strongly a material opposes current flow.

pop.q: In the comedy series Phoenix Nights, what is the name of Peter Kay's wheelchair-using club boss?
pop.why: Peter Kay played Phoenix Club licensee Brian Potter as well as doorman Eric Agnew.

pop.q: In the 1993 film Jurassic Park, which dinosaur is the very first that Alan Grant and Ellie Sattler see?
pop.why: The breathtaking reveal of the gentle herbivore Brachiosaurus is one of cinema's most iconic moments.

pop.q: Which TV presenter shot to fame in the late 1990s as the face of Boddingtons bitter adverts?
pop.why: Melanie Sykes famously served pints with the catchphrase 'It's your round, gorge!'

pop.q: When Tracy Island toys sold out in 1992, which Blue Peter presenter showed viewers how to make one?
pop.why: Anthea Turner's DIY Tracy Island received over 100,000 requests for the cardboard instruction sheet.

pop.q: On Cilla Black's hit ITV show Blind Date, what was the nickname of voiceover announcer Graham Skidmore?
pop.why: Cilla Black affectionately referred to Graham Skidmore as 'Our Graham' before he gave recaps.

music.q: Which song spent 15 consecutive weeks at UK Number 1 in 1994 for Wet Wet Wet?
music.why: Taken from Four Weddings and a Funeral, the band famously deleted the single while it was still near the top.

music.q: Which band headlined the Glastonbury Pyramid Stage in 2007, just over a year after their debut album?
music.why: They headlined on the Friday night following the record-breaking success of their debut and second albums.

music.q: Which comic book artist co-created the virtual band Gorillaz with Damon Albarn in 1998?
music.why: Hewlett, best known for creating the comic Tank Girl, designed the band's distinctive animated characters.

music.q: Which group won the 1976 Eurovision Song Contest for the UK with 'Save Your Kisses for Me'?
music.why: The single sold over six million copies worldwide, becoming one of the most commercially successful Eurovision hits.

music.q: Which Hollywood star starred in the continuous-shot music video for Elton John's 2001 single 'I Want Love'?
music.why: Directed by Sam Taylor-Johnson, the video was shot in an empty Beverly Hills mansion in a single take.

mix.q: Which Welsh rock band released the critically acclaimed 1996 album 'Everything Must Go'?
mix.why: The multi-platinum album featured hit singles including 'A Design for Life' and 'Kevin Carter'.

mix.q: In the sitcom 'The Inbetweeners', what make and model is Simon's yellow car with one red door?
mix.why: Simon's battered yellow Cinquecento famously lost its passenger door at Thorpe Park.

mix.q: What is the capital city of New Zealand?
mix.why: Auckland is New Zealand's most populous city, but Wellington has been the capital since 1865.

mix.q: Which girl group had their debut UK number one single with 'Sound of the Underground' in 2002?
mix.why: Formed on 'Popstars: The Rivals', Girls Aloud beat One True Voice to the 2002 Christmas number one.

mix.q: Which organ in the human body is primarily responsible for producing insulin?
mix.why: Islets of Langerhans within the pancreas produce insulin to regulate blood glucose.

mix.q: In the 1998 Coen brothers film 'The Big Lebowski', what is The Dude's cocktail of choice?
mix.why: Jeff Bridges' character drinks White Russians made with vodka, coffee liqueur, and cream.

mix.q: Which British electronic group released the hit 1997 album 'The Fat of the Land'?
mix.why: The album entered the UK chart at number one and included huge hits like 'Firestarter' and 'Breathe'.

mix.q: Which variety of British cooking apple was first cultivated in Nottinghamshire in the 1800s?
mix.why: All Bramley apple trees trace back to a single seedling planted in Southwell around 1809.

mix.q: In the N64 game GoldenEye 007, which multiplayer character was often banned for being too short?
mix.why: Oddjob's short stature meant players had to manually aim downwards to hit him in split-screen.

mix.q: Which English rock band released the 1979 album 'Reggatta de Blanc', featuring 'Message in a Bottle'?
mix.why: 'Reggatta de Blanc' was The Police's second studio album and their first UK number one.
